lines.text: Did you know about the dark truth behind Black Friday?
lines.speaker: DAISY

lines.text: Dark truth? It's just a shopping day... right?
lines.speaker: MILO

lines.text: That's what they... want you to think.
lines.speaker: DAISY

lines.text: Stores say it's the day they finally make money. They go from in the red, to in the black.
lines.speaker: DAISY

lines.text: Yeah... too nice. That's not where the name came from.
lines.speaker: DAISY

lines.text: The name actually came from cops in Philadelphia, back in the nineteen fifties and sixties.
lines.speaker: DAISY

lines.text: The day after Thanksgiving, the city turned into chaos. Huge crowds, traffic jams everywhere.
lines.speaker: DAISY

lines.text: It was! Police couldn't take the day off. They worked crazy long shifts. So they called it... Black Friday, because it was their worst day of the year.
lines.speaker: DAISY

lines.text: So how did it become a shopping holiday?
lines.speaker: MILO

lines.text: Stores hated the name, so they tried to rename it Big Friday.
lines.speaker: DAISY

lines.text: Nobody used it. So they just gave the old name a happy new story.
lines.speaker: DAISY

lines.text: Marketing! The real Black Friday started as a nightmare for the police.
lines.speaker: DAISY

lines.text: Subscribe to OnlyFreeFacts for more facts about everyday things!
lines.speaker: MILO
